verification: RCSB PDB entry identities and primary publications; local video production notes and the DD39 ligand element records in the migrated case data.

primary.description: Outward-facing bacterial ferroportin homologue with soaked iron.
Ca²⁺-bound BbFpn structure used for the inward-facing reference; the entry also contains a Ni–EDTA complex.

supplementary.description: Also supplies the experimental Ca²⁺ and Ni–EDTA context. These components come from the same primary reference, not a third PDB entry.

bbfpn.note: The retained protein overlay uses 6BTX. The current v3 video omits the separate Ca²⁺/Ni–EDTA scene; the structure is still documented here as supplementary context. Ca²⁺ and the Ni–EDTA complex are distinct components.

primary.description: Bacillus subtilis family II pyrophosphatase with an open catalytic cleft and Mn²⁺ sites.
Metal-free Bacillus subtilis pyrophosphatase, used as the second conformational reference.

supplementary.description: PNP substrate-analogue complex supplying the aligned analogue and Mg²⁺ positions. The PDB chemical-component code for PNP is 2PN.

bsppase.note: The principal domain-motion comparison uses 1K23 and 1WPM. PNP and Mg²⁺ from 2HAW are supplementary structural context; they are not constituents of the metal-free 1WPM reference.

primary.description: Human FAK catalytic-domain structure used as the receptor reference for this case.

fak-dd39.note: The ensemble comparison pairs the 4GU6-derived FAK receptor with DD-13M ligand 39 (DD39).

reference_policy: Structural references are restricted to the user-listed primary and supplementary PDB entries and their associated primary publications. Dataset and current-work references are included separately to attribute the displayed analyses; they do not introduce additional PDB structures.
